units.source_text: 随从人等便向公子劝请：“无论如何，请在天明以前上船。”

en.t: His attendants urged the prince, "Whatever happens, please board the boat before daybreak."

units.source_text: 源氏公子照例只带亲信四五人，登舟出发。

en.t: As usual, Prince Genji took only four or five trusted companions with him, boarded the boat, and set out.

units.source_text: 和来时一样又是一阵奇风，轻舟飞也似的到达了明石浦。

en.t: Just as on the journey there, a strange wind rose again, and the light boat seemed to fly as it reached the shore of Akashi.

units.source_text: 须磨与明石近在咫尺，本来就片时可到，

en.t: Suma and Akashi were very close to each other, and ordinarily one could arrive there in a short time,

units.source_text: 而今天特别迅速，竟像神风吹将过去似的。

en.t: but today the passage was especially swift, as though a divine wind had blown them across.
